entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It may be true that young people are[n]ignorant and reckless...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But that is absolutely no reason to[n]exploit them.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I hope that by taking down Kaneshiro,[n]there will be at least a few less victims.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That asshole talked big, but when push[n]came to shove, he hid behind his[n]bodyguards and that giant robot.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: He should fight his own goddamn battles.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Even his allies were bribed with money.[n]It's pitiful, honestly.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's not like anyone would side with him[n]on their own.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Friendship's gotta come from the heart,[n]y'know? Take a lesson from the Phantom[n]Thieves!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hehe... I agree.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I never would have thought of distracting[n]Kaneshiro with a valuable item.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You always remain calm and come up[n]with a plan, Morgana. It's impressive.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm glad you appreciate my splendor,[n]Makoto!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Keep the praise coming! In front of[n]Lady Ann, if possible.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yeah, yeah... I'll keep that in mind.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: This thing looks kinda like a piggy bank.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: That takes me back. I used to save all[n]my pocket change in one of those when[n]I was a kid.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: You kept your savings in an actual[n]piggy bank?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: You're weird, mister.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Is it that unusual...?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: *sigh* The generation gap sure does[n]weigh heavily sometimes.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: That man gorged himself on embezzled[n]funds, ultimately bringing about his own[n]downfall... How sad.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: That's the dark power of money.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Whether you got too much or too little,[n]it worms its way into your mind and[n]never lets go.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: It's... a terrifyin' thing.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: In my time reading fortunes, the name[n]"Kaneshiro" has come up a lot.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: All from people seeking help from me[n]because their luck had been so poor...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I think a lot of people had a weight lifted[n]from their shoulders when that man was[n]taken off the street.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's a relief to hear that. I'd like to believe[n]that means we did the right thing.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Say, Kaneshiro mentioned that there[n]was someone using other people's[n]Palaces to do whatever they pleased...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Yeah. I suppose that was me.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm surprised a petty criminal like him[n]had caught wind of me, though.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But Shido's the one who was takin'[n]advantage, yeah? I thought you were[n]just followin' orders.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Hm... It's not quite that simple.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'know... It IS a pig, right?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Indeed. A pig and a fly.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: This is my first time seeing it, but it looks[n]like a pig to me.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And then when we tried to open the[n]suitcase in the real world, Makoto[n]guessed the combination on the first try!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: The first try? Wow! You're amazing,[n]Makoto-senpai!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Now you see why she's our advisor!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Advisor, huh... You guys are always[n]exaggerating.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Queen, advisor, Fist of the Phantom[n]Star... You sure have a lot of titles,[n]Makoto-senpai.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Um... Could you kindly forget that last[n]one?
